module: MCP system tools: run Lua in the GE VM, read logs, reload the UI or Lua, render info, screenshots, file info, loading Lua files and extensions, reading/writing VariableRegistry variables.
notes: Security warning: run_lua and load_file run arbitrary code in the game; set_var modifies engine variables.
get_logs: the first call returns the last N lines of beamng.log (default 200, max 5000), subsequent ones only the new lines since the previous call (stored offset).
screenshot saves to <user folder>/screenshots/mcp/ (PNG or JPG) asynchronously; the path is returned immediately, the file may appear a few frames later.
screenshot_image: asynchronous in two calls; the result is a table {data=<base64 JPEG>, mimeType='image/jpeg'} that mcp_server converts into image content.
unload_extension refuses to unload mcp_server and mcp_tools.
reload_lua: the reload is deferred to the next frame; the MCP server restarts (onSerialize/onDeserialize) but the connection may drop.

run_lua.desc: Compiles (loadstring) and runs Lua code in the GE VM, returns tostring of the chunk's result.

args.desc: {code: string}. The code must `return …` to return a value.

get_logs.desc: Reads beamng.log (see notes for the first call / subsequent calls logic).

returns.desc: true if the file is unreadable.

reload_ui.desc: Fully reloads the UI (CEF) ignoring the cache, via reloadUI().

reload_lua.desc: Requests a reload of the GE Lua VM (like Ctrl+L) via Lua:requestReload; deferred to the next frame.

get_render_info.desc: Render info as JSON: adapterType, available, vulkanEnabled, gpu (Engine.Render / Engine.Platform).

screenshot.desc: Takes a screenshot (module `screenshot`, createScreenshotTracked) and returns its absolute path.

screenshot_image.desc: Captures a downscaled JPG and returns it as base64 (asynchronous in two calls).

file_info.desc: Information about a path: exists, isDir, realPath (VFS to disk), virtualPath, expanded and stat.

load_file.desc: Loads and runs a Lua file in the GE VM (the VFS path is resolved to the real path).

load_extension.desc: Loads a GE extension by its name (underscore form).

unload_extension.desc: Unloads a GE extension (mcp_server and mcp_tools are protected).

set_var.desc: Writes an engine variable (VariableRegistry.set) and returns the re-read value.

returns.desc: true if a parameter is missing.
